title: How Do I Challenge a Frightened Part of My Personality?
fullTitle: Soul Snack #21: How Do I Challenge a Frightened Part of My Personality?
description: In this Soul Snack, Gary explores the process of recognizing and challenging the frightened parts of our personality. He explains how these parts, rooted in fear, shape our experiences by driving emotions such as anger, jealousy, resentment, and insecurity.

Many people mistakenly believe they can eliminate fear-based behaviors through wishful thinking or intellectual understanding, but true transformation requires consistent practice. Gary shares personal stories, illustrating how the frightened parts of the personality lose their grip over time when we choose love over fear again and again . He emphasizes that growth is not about erasing fear, but about making conscious choices in the face of it.
This daily practice of emotional awareness and conscious choice is how we create authentic power and lasting transformation.
Are you creating with love or fear in your life? Take this self-assessment today to find out.
